node: Critical semiconductor materials and consumables exposed to policy resilience
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around semiconductor materials and consumables that could become policy-resilience chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed lane is not the obvious fab or equipment leaders, but suppliers of high-purity materials, CMP and cleaning chemistries, filtration/purification, compound substrates, deposition materials, and advanced-packaging process chemicals. Candidate inclusion here is research-only and not a trading recommendation. ENTG is kept as a reference/pure-play anchor, while MTRN, AXTI, and MKSI are included as underfollowed or lower-attention discovery candidates with explicit verification needs.
